units.title: Act: Replace game/node_modules/ with node_modules/ in .gitignore
Act: Add isIgnoredByDirRule helper for .gitignore directory rules
Verify: .gitignore holds depth-independent node_modules/ rule unit tests

tests.id: gitignoreRule.test.ts > contains the depth-independent node_modules/ rule
tests.name: contains the depth-independent node_modules/ rule
tests.title: repository .gitignore node_modules rule contains the depth-independent node_modules/ rule
tests.scenario: Given the repository-root .gitignore on disk, when its lines are read, then the bare node_modules/ rule is present so it matches at any depth.
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gitignoreRule.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: gitignoreRule.test.ts > does not contain the game-scoped game/node_modules/ rule
tests.name: does not contain the game-scoped game/node_modules/ rule
tests.title: repository .gitignore node_modules rule does not contain the game-scoped game/node_modules/ rule
tests.scenario: Given the repository-root .gitignore on disk, when its lines are read, then no game/node_modules/ rule remains that would only ignore one depth.
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gitignoreRule.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: game/frontend/node_modules is covered by the real .gitignore unit tests

tests.name: ignores game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json using the real .gitignore
tests.title: ignores game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json using the real .gitignore
tests.scenario: Given the repository-root .gitignore read from disk, when the helper checks game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json, then the depth-independent node_modules/ rule ignores it.
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gitignoreCoverage.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: gitignoreCoverage > game/node_modules/ alone does not cover game/frontend/node_modules
tests.name: does not ignore game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json when only game/node_modules/ is listed
tests.title: does not ignore game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json when only game/node_modules/ is listed
tests.scenario: Given an ignore file containing only the game-scoped game/node_modules/ rule, when the helper checks game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json, then the path is not ignored because the rule only covers one depth.
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gitignoreCoverage.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

units.title: REQ · .gitignore uses a depth-independent node_modules/ rule
